problems.title: Cheapest pillar route
problems.statement: You are given an array `heights` of `n` integers (the heights of consecutive pillars) and an integer `k` (max jump reach). You start on pillar 0 and must reach pillar n-1. From pillar i you may jump to any pillar j with i < j <= i + k. The cost of a jump from i to j is abs(heights[i] - heights[j]). Return the minimum total cost over the whole trip. If n == 1 return 0.

problems.statement: Given a string s and an integer k, return the length of the longest contiguous substring of s that contains at most k distinct characters. If the string is empty return 0. If k is 0 return 0.

problems.title: Grid with key and door
problems.statement: You are given a rectangular grid of characters: 'S' start, 'E' exit, '#' wall, '.' free floor, 'K' a key, 'D' a locked door. You move up/down/left/right one cell per step onto any cell that is not a wall. A door 'D' can only be entered after collecting the key 'K' (there is at most one 'K' and at most one 'D'). Return the minimum number of steps from S to E, or -1 if unreachable. Note: passing through K is optional if there is no D on the path.

problems.title: Minimum meeting rooms
problems.statement: You are given a list of meetings, each a tuple (start, end) with integer times (end is exclusive, start < end). A meeting occupies a room for the whole half-open interval [start, end). Return the minimum number of rooms needed so that no two simultaneously-running meetings share a room. Meetings that touch at endpoints (one ends exactly when another starts) do not conflict. An empty list returns 0.

problems.title: Integer expression evaluator
problems.statement: Given a string containing a single arithmetic expression with non-negative integers, the operators +, -, * and /, and round parentheses, evaluate it. Division is integer division truncating toward zero (like C). Whitespace must be ignored. Operator precedence: * and / before + and -, left-to-right for operators of equal precedence. The expression is guaranteed syntactically valid. Return the integer result.
